pMQBSPgHaldfi9iE.description: Choose your street-grade cyberdeck — your Kit slot. Any Hacker can run any deck: Nyx Cartel “Switchblade” (Disruptor-leaning), Ferrum “Padlock-6” (Controller-leaning), or Meridian “Lookout” (Support-leaning). (Quick Build: your doctrine’s deck.)
